CATALOG_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: What your team sends in conversations: photo, price and details, all in one place.

LIST.EMPTY: Nothing here yet. Add {items} to send them in conversations.
LIST.ERROR: We could not load the catalog. Try again in a moment.

FORM.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save. Try again in a moment.
FORM.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load it. Try again in a moment.

PHOTOS.LABEL: Photos
PHOTOS.HINT: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB. The first photo is the cover. 800x800 is recommended, which is the size WhatsApp shows.
PHOTOS.INVALID_TYPE: {name} is not a JPG or PNG file.
PHOTOS.REMOVE_ERROR: We could not remove this photo. Try again in a moment.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.PRICE_HINT: Optional. Without a price, no price is shown.

CUSTOM_FIELDS.TITLE: Fields
CUSTOM_FIELDS.INTERNAL_HINT: Internal field: not shown to the customer.

PUBLISH.TITLE: Publishing
PUBLISH.VISIBLE_HINT: Shows up for the agent to send
PUBLISH.FEATURED_HINT: Pins it to the top of the list

SYNC.TITLE: Sync
SYNC.QUEUED: Sync queued. It stays pending until Meta confirms it.
SYNC.ERROR: We could not queue the sync. Try again in a moment.
SYNC.HIDDEN: Hidden items are removed from Meta on the next sync.

CATEGORIES.DESCRIPTION: Categories organize the catalog and filter the list. Deleting a category does not delete its items.

EMPTY.TITLE: No categories yet
EMPTY.HINT: Create the first one to organize the catalog.

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Delete the category {name}?
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: {n} {items} will have no category. No item is deleted.

API.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the categories. Try again in a moment.
API.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save the category.
API.DELETE_ERROR: We could not delete the category.

STANDARD.TITLE: Standard fields
STANDARD.DESCRIPTION: What the item is called in this account and which standard fields show up in the form.
STANDARD.SKU_HINT: The SKU is still used by the ERP integration and by the Meta mirror.
STANDARD.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save. Try again in a moment.

CUSTOM.TITLE: Custom fields
CUSTOM.DESCRIPTION: One set of fields for every item. Empty fields are not shown.
CUSTOM.INTERNAL_LABEL: Internal field (not shown to the customer)

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Delete the field {name}?
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: The field disappears from the form, the card and the message to the customer.

CUSTOM.DELETE_ERROR: We could not delete the field.

INTEGRATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Connect the catalog to other systems.

META.TITLE: Meta
META.DESCRIPTION: Mirrors the visible items to the Meta catalog. Requires an official WhatsApp inbox in this account.
META.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save. Try again in a moment.
META.SYNC_HINT: Save the catalog ID to be able to sync.

SYNC_ALL.QUEUED: Sync queued. Items update as Meta confirms them.
SYNC_ALL.ERROR: We could not queue the sync. Try again in a moment.

META_STATUS.PENDING_HINT: Goes to Meta on the next sync
META_STATUS.MISSING_HINT: Meta needs {missing} to accept this item
